arduous--adj.def: Needing a great deal of effort over a long time.
arduous--adj.ex: The climb was long and arduous.

quiver--verb.def: To shake with small rapid movements.
quiver--verb.ex: His lip quivered as he spoke.

quiver--noun.def: A slight trembling, or a case for carrying arrows.
quiver--noun.ex: A quiver ran through the crowd.

frolic--verb.def: To play and jump about in a happy, carefree way.

recourse--noun.def: The option of turning to someone or something for help.

blight--noun.def: A disease that kills plants, or something that spoils life.
blight--noun.ex: Unemployment is a blight on the town.

blight--verb.def: To spoil something so it cannot develop properly.

innuendo--noun.def: An indirect remark that hints at something rude or critical.
innuendo--noun.ex: The article was full of innuendo.

angst--noun.def: A strong feeling of anxiety about life and the future.

accountability--noun.def: The duty to explain your decisions and accept blame.
accountability--noun.exTr: Seçmen daha fazla hesap verebilirlik istedi.

figuratively--adv.def: In a way that uses words for effect rather than literally.

superfluous--adj.def: More than is needed and therefore unnecessary.

depravity--noun.exTr: Dava sarsıcı bir ahlaki çöküşü ortaya serdi.

adept--adj.def: Very skilled at doing something difficult.
adept--adj.ex: She is adept at reading people.

adept--noun.def: A person who is highly skilled in an art or craft.
adept--noun.ex: Only an adept can tune it.
adept--noun.exTr: Onu ancak bir uzman akort edebilir.

poise--verb.def: To hold something balanced and ready to move.
poise--verb.ex: She poised the pen above the form.

diffuse--adj.def: Spread out widely and lacking a clear focus.
diffuse--adj.ex: The light in the room was diffuse.

diffuse--verb.def: To spread through an area or among people.

deterrent--noun.def: Something that stops people from acting through fear.
deterrent--noun.exTr: Kameralar caydırıcı bir unsur işlevi görüyor.

haughty--adj.def: Proud and treating others as inferior.

vandal--noun.def: A person who destroys property for no good reason.

jargon--noun.def: Special words used by a profession that outsiders find hard.

forlorn--adj.def: Looking lonely, sad and without hope.
forlorn--adj.ex: A forlorn dog waited by the gate.
forlorn--adj.exTr: Kapının yanında hüzünlü bir köpek bekledi.

meticulously--adv.def: With very careful attention to every detail.

conglomerate--noun.def: A large company made of many different businesses.
conglomerate--noun.ex: A media conglomerate bought the paper.
conglomerate--noun.exTr: Bir medya holdingi gazeteyi satın aldı.

practitioner--noun.def: Someone who works in a skilled profession such as medicine or law.

punitive--adj.def: Intended as a punishment, often a harsh one.

blubber--noun.def: The thick layer of fat under the skin of sea mammals.
blubber--noun.ex: Whale blubber keeps the animal warm.

turret--noun.def: A small tower on a building, or a gun tower on a tank.
turret--noun.ex: A turret rises above the gate.
turret--noun.exTr: Kapının üstünde küçük bir kule yükseliyor.

shimmer--verb.def: To shine with a soft trembling light.

emulate--verb.def: To copy someone you admire in order to do as well.

cinematographer--noun.def: The person responsible for filming and lighting a film.

resuscitate--verb.def: To bring someone back to consciousness, or to revive something failing.

imposition--noun.def: An unfair demand on someone, or the forcing of a rule.
imposition--noun.ex: Staying late felt like an imposition.
imposition--noun.exTr: Geç kalmak bir yük gibi geldi.

elated--adj.def: Extremely happy because of a success.
elated--adj.ex: She was elated by the result.

ingrate--noun.def: A person who shows no thanks for help received.
ingrate--noun.ex: He called his nephew an ingrate.

reptilian--adj.def: Like a reptile, or cold and unfeeling in manner.
reptilian--adj.exTr: Soğukkanlı, sürüngensi hâli bizi tedirgin etti.

abject--adj.def: Extremely bad, or showing complete loss of dignity.
abject--adj.exTr: Milyonlarca kişi sefil bir yoksullukta yaşıyor.

magnate--noun.def: A rich and powerful person in business or industry.
magnate--noun.ex: A shipping magnate funded the museum.
magnate--noun.exTr: Bir denizcilik kodamanı müzeyi finanse etti.

banishment--noun.def: The punishment of being sent away from your country.

fabricate--verb.def: To invent a false story, or to manufacture something.

aberration--noun.def: A single event that differs from what is normal.
aberration--noun.ex: The loss was a rare aberration.

abundantly--adv.def: In large amounts, or very clearly.

incumbent--noun.def: The person currently holding an official post.
incumbent--noun.ex: The incumbent lost by ten votes.

incumbent--adj.def: Currently holding a post, or forming someone's duty.
incumbent--adj.ex: It is incumbent on us to reply.

spontaneity--noun.def: The quality of acting freely without planning.

swivel--verb.def: To turn round while staying in one place.

methodology--noun.def: The set of methods used in a study or field of work.

clinch--verb.def: To settle a deal or victory finally.
clinch--verb.ex: A late goal clinched the title.

unnerving--adj.def: Making you lose confidence or feel uneasy.

prissy--adj.def: Too concerned with neatness and correct behaviour.
prissy--adj.ex: Do not be so prissy about mud.

resuscitation--noun.def: The act of reviving someone who has stopped breathing.

recuperate--verb.def: To get better after illness or great effort.
recuperate--verb.ex: He is recuperating at his sister's.

lyrical--adj.def: Expressing feeling in a beautiful, songlike way.
lyrical--adj.ex: The novel has a lyrical opening.

assimilate--verb.def: To take in information fully, or to become part of a group.

rife--adj.def: Very common, said of something unpleasant.

intermediary--noun.def: A person who carries messages between two sides.
intermediary--noun.ex: A neutral intermediary arranged the talks.

proprietary--adj.def: Owned by a company and protected from copying.

hindrance--noun.def: Something that makes progress more difficult.
hindrance--noun.ex: The rules are more hindrance than help.

repose--verb.def: To rest quietly in a comfortable position.
repose--verb.ex: The cat reposed on the sill.

magnanimous--adj.def: Generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival.

depressive--adj.def: Relating to or causing deep, lasting sadness.

parameter--noun.def: A fixed limit or value that defines how something works.

ebb--verb.def: To flow back, as the tide does, or to grow weaker.

allotment--noun.def: A share given to someone, or a small rented garden plot.
allotment--noun.ex: He grows beans on his allotment.

mediate--verb.def: To help two opposing sides reach an agreement.

behest--noun.def: An order or urgent request from someone in authority.
behest--noun.ex: He resigned at the king's behest.

philistine--noun.def: Someone who has no interest in art or culture.
philistine--noun.ex: Critics called the mayor a philistine.
philistine--noun.exTr: Eleştirmenler belediye başkanına sanattan anlamaz dedi.

menial--adj.def: Needing little skill and carrying little status.
menial--adj.ex: He took menial work to survive.

resounding--adj.def: Very great and impossible to doubt.
resounding--adj.ex: The play was a resounding success.

stratosphere--noun.def: The layer of the atmosphere high above the clouds.

embody--verb.def: To be a clear example of an idea or quality.

materialistic--adj.def: Caring more about money and possessions than other values.
materialistic--adj.ex: He grew up in a materialistic age.

solicit--verb.def: To ask formally for money, help or opinions.

austerity--noun.def: Strict limits on spending, or a plain way of living.
austerity--noun.ex: Years of austerity followed the crisis.
austerity--noun.exTr: Krizin ardından yıllarca kemer sıkma geldi.

precocious--adj.def: Showing adult ability at an unusually young age.
